The '''Sky Lancer control center''' was a facility that controlled the [[Argent Sky Lancers]] on [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] took over the control center and flipped the satellites to fire down on the surface of the planet.
